dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install poetry' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN poetry install --with dev

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed


cd /testbed

set +e
(
poetry run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

excluded_commands.command: poetry run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings (test command, not build)

build_recipe.rationale: The agent successfully set up the environment by installing Poetry and then installing the project dependencies with dev extras. Only these two commands mutate the environment and are required for the image. The test command collects tests but does not modify state, so it is placed in test_commands for runtime execution.
